detail.longDescription:
PDF Reader is an Android home screen launcher with built-in PDF tools. It gives you quick access to your apps, search, weather, news, and common PDF features directly from your home screen.

🗂️ PDF FEATURES & FILES

• Open and view PDF files
• Scan documents into PDF
• Merge PDF files
• Split PDF files
• Convert PDF pages to images

Available features may vary depending on your device and app version.

📱 YOUR EVERYDAY HOME

PDF Reader can also work as your Android home screen launcher.

• Access installed apps from your home screen
• Use the built-in web search bar
• Swipe to access available news and content
• Quickly open weather and PDF tools
• Customize your everyday home screen experience

⚙️ CHOOSE YOUR HOME APP

During setup, you can choose whether to set PDF Reader as your default Home app.

If you choose to enable it, Android will use PDF Reader for your home screen and app launcher experience. You can change your default Home app again at any time from your device settings.

🌐 SEARCH FROM HOME

PDF Reader includes a web search feature directly on the home screen. Search results are provided through the search service available in the app.

Using the home screen search feature does not prevent you from using other browsers or search apps installed on your device.

🛡️ PRIVACY & PERMISSIONS

Some optional features may require device permissions.

• Location may be used to display local weather information when you use the weather feature.
• Notifications may be used for optional shortcuts, weather information, and app-related notifications.

You can manage available permissions at any time through your device settings. Features that depend on a permission may be unavailable if that permission is disabled.

PDF Reader brings PDF tools, apps, search, weather, and everyday shortcuts together in one home screen experience.
